title: Harbor eval live
description: Harbor trial/verifier live view. Streams while the run is open and restores from the persisted terminal snapshot after it settles.

inputs.name: stream
inputs.description: Declared live SSE or fixture with trial/verifier events. Absent once the producer has sealed and closed the run.

inputs.name: experiment
inputs.description: Persisted terminal projection for the same run. A reopened or settled visual renders from this instead of waiting on a closed stream; missing usage stays unavailable rather than zero.

inputs.name: optimizer_run
inputs.description: The optimizer run this visual belongs to, for navigation to its trace workstation.
